mapper.delete: DELETE FROM arte_rt_share WHERE resource_type = #{resourceType} AND resource_id = #{resourceId}
mapper.select: WITH RECURSIVE ancestors AS ( SELECT id, father_id FROM arte_rt_catalog WHERE id = #{catalogId} UNION ALL SELECT c.id, c.father_id FROM arte_rt_catalog c INNER JOIN ancestors a ON c.id = a.father_id ) SELECT s.id, s.resource_type, s.resource_id, s.target_user, s.target_type, s.target_role, s.permission, s.article_permission, s.create_by, s.create_time FROM arte_rt_share s WHERE ( (s.resource_type = 'ARTICLE' AND s.resource_id = #{articleId}) OR (s.resource_type = 'CATALOG' AND s.resource_id IN (SELECT id FROM ancestors)) ) AND ( (s.target_type = 'USER' AND s.target_user = #{targetUser}) OR (s.target_type = 'ROLE' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM arte_rbac_relation rr WHERE rr.binding_type = 'user_to_role' AND rr.source = #{targetUser} AND rr.target = s.target_role )) )

WITH RECURSIVE ancestors AS ( SELECT id, father_id FROM arte_rt_catalog WHERE id = #{catalogId} UNION ALL SELECT c.id, c.father_id FROM arte_rt_catalog c INNER JOIN ancestors a ON c.id = a.father_id ) SELECT s.id, s.resource_type, s.resource_id, s.target_user, s.target_type, s.target_role, s.permission, s.article_permission, s.create_by, s.create_time FROM arte_rt_share s WHERE s.resource_type = 'CATALOG' AND s.resource_id IN (SELECT id FROM ancestors) AND ( (s.target_type = 'USER' AND s.target_user = #{targetUser}) OR (s.target_type = 'ROLE' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM arte_rbac_relation rr WHERE rr.binding_type = 'user_to_role' AND rr.source = #{targetUser} AND rr.target = s.target_role )) )

WITH RECURSIVE ancestors AS ( SELECT c.id, c.father_id FROM arte_rt_article a INNER JOIN arte_rt_catalog c ON c.id = a.catalog_id WHERE a.id = #{articleId} AND a.is_delete = 0 UNION ALL SELECT c.id, c.father_id FROM arte_rt_catalog c INNER JOIN ancestors a ON c.id = a.father_id ) SELECT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM arte_rt_article a WHERE a.id = #{articleId} AND a.is_delete = 0 AND ( a.create_by = #{targetUser} OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM arte_rt_share s WHERE ( (s.resource_type = 'ARTICLE' AND s.resource_id = #{articleId} AND s.permission IN ('COMMENT', 'READ_WRITE', 'FULL_CONTROL')) OR (s.resource_type = 'CATALOG' AND s.resource_id IN (SELECT id FROM ancestors) AND s.article_permission IN ('COMMENT', 'READ_WRITE', 'FULL_CONTROL')) ) AND ( (s.target_type = 'USER' AND s.target_user = #{targetUser}) OR (s.target_type = 'ROLE' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM arte_rbac_relation rr WHERE rr.binding_type = 'user_to_role' AND rr.source = #{targetUser} AND rr.target = s.target_role )) ) ) ) )
